ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels across the majority of the surface area, with approximately 5-8% high-intensity (white/light grey) pixels concentrated in localized clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Discontinuous high-contrast circular clusters (rosettes) located primarily on the lateral lobes. The central region near the notch and peduncle consists of a contiguous low-intensity dark mapping with minor pixel-level variations.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations (peaks and valleys) visible along the entire boundary from the median notch to the lateral tips, with a higher peak density on the right lobe.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Overall convex trajectory of the trailing edge sweeping upward towards the tips, with a slight concavity transition as the edge approaches the median notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several horizontal and vertical linear pixel disruptions, notably a distinct horizontal mark located approximately 40 pixels to the right of the median notch axis.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of high-intensity, textured pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes, suggesting significant barnacle colonization or physical trauma.
